name: mma_smem_2warp
desc: MULTI-WARP (2 warps/64 threads) cooperative cp.async (LDGSTS) staging GLOBAL->shared, then per-warp HMMA.16816.F32 over the shared tile. Fills the coverage gap between single-warp hmma_loop/hmma_ldsm (block=32, no LDGSTS) and the 4-warp 41_fmha kernel. Isolates multi-warp+LDGSTS+smem+HMMA and runs x86 BIT-EXACT (warp0 D=16, warp1 D=32, all 128 outputs each).
gpu_ref: none (CPU oracle in driver: constant-tile GEMM)
note: ref_output.bin is intentionally absent; the driver performs a layout-agnostic constant-tile check.
